title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Valet 49-In Solid Brass | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Need towel storage without wall drilling? This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel valet is a floor towel stand (also called a towel rack or towel holder) that creates dedicated space for bath towels in the bathroom.

Highlights:
- Hang and separate multiple towels with 4 pivoting swing arms that rotate for easy access and better spacing
- Put it anywhere—freestanding floor design requires no wall mount, wall-mounted hardware, or wall hanging installation
- Stay stable on the floor with a large weighted base designed to help prevent tipping
- Built for enduring bathroom use with solid brass construction engineered to resist rust and corrosion
- Coordinate a cohesive look with the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Details:
- Type: freestanding floor towel valet / towel stand / towel rack / towel holder
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 10.5 in.
- Shipping weight: 17 lbs
- Assembly: some assembly required
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
- Made in the USA
